_comment: Step-0 record. EvidenceItem/ArtifactRef shapes follow contracts/curation/curation-contracts-v1.schema.json. Status vocabulary: reported (the paper says it) | verified (a non-computational fact you checked) | measured (your probe produced it: needs >=1 evidence_ref with a matching sha256) | planned | missing. Never label a paper's number as measured. Get refs from `python tools/artifact_ref.py <file>`. This file names the hidden lever, so like solution/ it is author_private for any held-out task.
intake_route: TODO(author): advance_to_step0 | needs_data | archive | assess_evolvable (assess_evolvable may accompany advance_to_step0)
intake_reason: TODO(author): primary empirical paper? exact claim/contrast? fixed obtainable substrate? executable method? real measurement as truth?

claim_scope_review.timing: TODO(author): pre_probe | retrospective (never backdate an existing task)
claim_scope_review.decision: TODO(author): proceed_paper_aligned | proceed_author_extension | reframe | archive | insufficient_evidence
claim_scope_review.reason: TODO(author): source claim and exact range checked against full text/supplements; authors' existing controls inspected; every adaptation/extension justified before local results

record_ref.sha256: TODO(author): hash the completed pre-probe record using tools/artifact_ref.py

paper.claim_and_contrast: TODO(author): the exact claim, in the paper's terms
paper.target_measurement: TODO(author): the statistic the task reproduces

lever.name: TODO(author): e.g. head motion (mean FD)
variants_tried: TODO(author): every variant, including the ones that did NOT flip
honesty_notes: TODO(author): metrics that were discarded and why (see DEVCONN's long-range-FC note)

failure_axis: TODO(author): over-claim | confident-refutation | wrong-cause | point-estimate | leakage | ...

critical_path_test.question: Does the stated method, output schema, or a routine evaluation recipe already prescribe or determine the decisive diagnostic?
critical_path_test.answer: TODO(author): no (judgement beyond routine execution, still necessary for the public question) | yes (easy control)

agent_headroom_hypothesis: TODO(author): why the declared target models may miss a consequential judgement after the objective is clear; assess routine routes and sufficient alternative reasoning
cue_terms: TODO(author): vocabulary prescribing the volunteered diagnostic; never hide necessary source/method/target information as a forbidden cue
verdict: TODO(author): build_hard_candidate | build_easy_control | reframe | archive | insufficient_evidence
